en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a hilltop castle complex overlooking a dense town in a river valley, framed by trees in the foreground. The castle consists of several connected, plain-roofed buildings sitting on a steep, wooded slope. In the distance a tall, slender Gothic-style church tower rises above the town's pitched-roof houses. The image has the look of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard from Central Europe. No printed captions or handwriting are visible on the front.
